description: Convert an address to lat/lng (forward: pass address), or lat/lng to an address (reverse: pass latitude and longitude). Use when the user needs coordinates or a normalized address, or before places_nearby. To find businesses use places_search_text; directions accepts addresses directly, so geocoding first is not required. Returns formatted address, lat/lng, place_id, types, and plus code.
name: geocode
title: Geocode
